Sent in by students who would've appreciated a poster or two to announce the change.

A "space-locator" pat to the woman in the library on Monday night who helped us find a place to rehearse our presentation. Sent in by a group of students whose grades depended on getting together to practice.

An "expensive-mistake" dart to the JMU parking staff for giving my father a parking ticket during Homecoming weekend. Sent in by a student who now realizes a $20 ticket is more important to the university than my father's annual $10,000 donation which no longer exists.

A "heartfelt" pat to the JMU education department for the beautiful memorial to Ann Olson. It was very touching to those of us who still hold Ann close to our hearts. Sent in by a Spanky's employee who made it through another day because of your warm and giving efforts.

A "you-wonder-why-Harrisonburg-residents-tend-to-think-JMU-students-are-snobs" dart to the harsh critics of Pano's restaurant. Sent in by a student who happens to enjoy Pano's cuisine and thinks snotty JMU students are in no place to judge.

A "go-Dukes" pat to everyone who came out for Midnight Madness! We greatly appreciate your support and hope to see you all at this season's games. Sent in by Coach "Lefty" Driesell and the 1996-97 JMU men's basketball team.
sender: Coach "Lefty" Driesell and the 1996-97 JMU men's basketball team

text: A "let's-show-some-initiative" dart to the maintenance crew that has yet to repair the shattered backboard and broken rim on the two Lakeside basketball goals. Sent in by a student who is anxious to show off his mad skills to "Lefty."

A "thank-you-for-not-killing-me" pat to the adorable little blonde with the strained shoulder that I hurt even more when I tried to twirl you around while we were dancing at Sigma Pi. Sent in by a student who would love to take you out and make up for it. I promise we won't go dancing this time!

A "just-because-daddy's-got-the-big-bucks-doesn't-mean-he-can-park-anywhere-he-wants" dart to the student who was surprised his dad got a parking ticket Homecoming weekend. Sent in by a student who knows there are only 30 parking spots for 13,000 students, and making your own spot will get you a ticket whether you donate $10,000 or not.

A "don't-you-know-you're-beautiful" pat to the hottie in the red soccer shirt with the piercing blue eyes at UREC Tuesday afternoon. You made us smile. Sent in by two upperclasswomen whose day was made brighter by knowing there are still cute guys at JMU who aren't stuck on themselves.
A "thanks-for-nothing" dart to The Breeze for never printing the darts and pats I submit. Sent in by a student who [incorrectly] bets that this dart won't even be printed.

A "couldn't-have-done-it-without-you" pat to all the dedicated volunteers who have spent long hours working to get the Women's Resource Center together. Sent in by a very thankful and appreciative coordinator of the Women's Resource Center.
sender: a very thankful and appreciative coordinator of the Women's Resource Center

text: A "control-your-libido" dart to the lovey-dovey couple in Zane Showker Hall who find it necessary to do everything short of sex in the halls between classes. Sent in by people who understand that Zane Showker is an attractive building but people making out in it are not.

A "thanks-for-everything-you-do-for-the-lab-when-it's-closed" pat to Greg in housekeeping who goes out of his way to make sure the College of Business computer lab is extra clean every night. Sent in by all the members of the COB computing support.
sender: all the members of the COB computing support

text: A "learn-how-to-play-with-your-balls" dart to the members of the JMU water polo team whose bad shots fly out of their practice area and into the lanes. Sent in by a student who would like to swim at UREC without always having to yell "incoming" after each lap.

A "thanks-for-making-it-feel-like-Bridgeforth" pat to the Marching Royal Dukes for their fine performance this weekend at Delaware. Sent in by a couple of JMU students who found the friendly faces and familiar sounds comforting in such a strange place.

A "try-talking-instead-of-stalking" dart to the people who have recently been sending in pats to the beautiful people at UREC whom they watch from a distance, yet never have the guts to talk to. Sent in by a student who thinks you should all get some self-confidence.
A "you-saved-my-paper-and-my-night" pat to Kim at the Zane Showker Hall computer lab. I'd still be sitting there if you hadn't helped me. Sent in by the guy in the green hat with the stubborn disk.
sender: the guy in the green hat

text: A "quit-heckling-Duke-Dog" dart to the drunken guy who insists on showing up at every sports event and belittling Duke Dog. Sent in by students who would appreciate it if you stopped because they love that pooch.

A "thanks-for-all-you-do" pat to Dr. Christina McDonald in the English Department for training and spending time with us this semester. We appreciate your wisdom, advice and time. Sent in by the well-trained staff of the FYI Writing Center who applaud Dr. McDonald's commitment to students and all of her volunteer hours.

A "stinkin'-stogie" dart to the two inconsiderate cigar smokers who insist on lighting up outside Ikenberry Hall after midnight and smelling up the dorm. Sent in by a student who wishes you would have some respect for your lungs and the noses of others.

A "congratulations-on-being-selected-Virginia-State-Social-Work-Educator-of-the-Year" pat to JMU social work department's very own professor Greg Versen. Sent in by students who agree that your enthusiasm, encouragement and commitment deserve recognition.
target: JMU social work department's very own professor Greg Versen

text: A "hold-your-horses" dart to the inconsiderate students in Dr. Staib's 9:25 astronomy class. Officially, you have nowhere to be for 35 minutes, so sit still and be quiet until you are dismissed. Sent in by two upperclassmen who were taught to respect those who are speaking, especially college professors.

A "thanks-for-your-time-and-patience" pat to Mrs. Housden in the math department for being there at all times when we need to see a real person and one who will take the time to lend a helping hand. Sent in by several students who appreciate someone willing to help others.

A "learn-how-to-use-spell-check" dart to the person who wrote the University Program Board calendar for November and December. I was shocked to see more than 20 spelling mistakes. Sent in by a student neurotic enough to highlight and count all of them.

A "dios-mio-what-a-performance" pat to Jessica Browne-White for her wonderful portrayal of Marisol on Friday night. Sent in by a student who appreciates fine theatre, especially when it involves talented actresses like Jessica.

A "move-to-the-other-side-of-the-stands" dart to all the Dukes "fans" who felt the need to boo their own team at Saturday's game. Show a little school spirit! Sent in by three real Dukes fans who don't change sides when the going gets tough.

A "life-saver" pat to whomever called campus police about my car's lights being on. I was glad someone showed such consideration. Sent in by a student who was afraid when awakened by the police but would rather get up than be greeted by a dead battery in the morning.

A "you-are-insolent-and-sanctimonious-pigs" dart to all the professors on campus who think they are too good to give course overrides. Sent in by a senior who really wants to graduate and thinks some professors either need to get a grip or get an enema.

A "thanks-for-all-the-smiles-and-hard-work" pat to the music majors who never fail to brighten up the music library. Sent in by a student library assistant who really appreciates your live performances and is glad there is something happy about her job.

A "thanks-for-keeping-in-touch-with-us" dart to all the JMU students who have forgotten about their friends who are studying abroad. Sent in by someone who loves to hear from an American, but seldom does.

A "you-rocked-my-Sunday-brunch" pat to D-hall for finally serving chicken stuffed with broccoli again. We've been anticipating it for weeks, and you finally came through. Sent in by two students who wish those chicken thingys and Lucky Charms would become a regular part of the fare.

A "thanks-for-doing-your-job" pat to the Shorts Hall RAs for finally cracking down on alcohol in the building. It's about time we made the substance-free dorm substance free. Sent in by a resident who actually understood what substance-free meant when they defined it on the first day.

A "thanks-for-the-water" dart to whomever keyed into my room after I had left for break and unplugged my refrigerator. Sent in by a student who doesn't appreciate ruined books and a warped cabinet due to the wet mess.

A "job-well-done" pat to the dedicated staff members at UREC, Taylor Down Under and the University Center who sponsored a wonderfully successful ACU-1 Region Recreation and College Bowl tournament. Sent in by someone who is grateful to have a chance to work with such fine people.

A "highly-unprofessional" dart to J. Willoby's Roadhouse for only offering us a 10 percent discount for the appetizer with a long hair in it that we refused to eat. Sent in by several students who walked out after finding another hair in their french fries and being told they were rude for complaining about it.

A "thanks-for-the-random-act-of-kindness" pat to the two nursing majors and the member of Lambda Chi Alpha fraternity who were kind enough to come to my rescue when I fell and sprained my ankle outside Zane Showker Hall. Sent in by a student who is grateful for their generosity and probably still would be stuck on the side of the road without you.
target: the two nursing majors and the member

text: A "what's-your-name?" dart to the cashier at D-hall who insists on greeting me on a first-name basis twice a day but doesn't wear a name tag. Sent in by a student who believes it's only fair for D-hall customers to have the same privileges as employees.

A "thanks-for-your-Let's Go!-containers" pat to the many students who contributed their Let's Go! containers to our fundraiser for the Alternative Spring Break trip to the youth center in Florida. You helped raise over $700, and we couldn't have done it without you. Sent in by two students who went door-to-door collecting containers to raise money for the children at the Johnson-Brinson Project, Inc.

A "hope-you-had-fun" dart to the members of Sigma Alpha Epsilon fraternity who embarrassed JMU and the Greek system over spring break by offering their services to Habitat for Humanity in Miami only to back out after half a day's work. Sent in by a student who knows how rewarding and fun community service is and knows those guys really missed out.
A "thanks-for-all-the-support-and-encouragement" pat to Jenny Rudalf, the best hall director White Hall could ask for. Sent in by suite A301, who appreciates her sincere concern for her residents.
A "you-can't-fool-me" dart to D-hall for putting those cheap cornflakes in the Nut and Honey Crunch bin. Sent in by a Nut and Honey Crunch lover who knows the difference.
sender: a Nut and Honey Crunch lover

text: A "thanks-for-the-hard-work" pat to Lee Shifflett of Campus Police for being so cooperative in the effort to produce an orientation video for Human Resources. Sent in by an appreciative video coordinator who understands the complications of scheduling.

A "smoking's-bad-for-your-baby-too" dart to the pregnant faculty member who was smoking a cigarette while walking across the Quad. Sent in by a concerned student who smokes but would kick the habit in the interest of an unborn child.

A "good-morning" pat to the smiling employees at PC Dukes who manage to be bright and cheery even at 8 a.m. Sent in by a white-haired girl who gets up every day at dawn and tries to be equally bright and cheerful.

An "I-want-my-mail" dart to JMU Postal Services for returning all of my mail to senders although I am an on-campus resident and have been here all semester. Sent in by a student who loves getting mail and was devastated when she didn't receive even campus fliers.

A "way-to-go" pat to the women's softball team for winning both games in a doubleheader against Loyola University last weekend. Sent in by a player who thinks JMU sports club teams need recognition for their hard work and accomplishments.

A "stop-the-racism" dart to UPB for sponsoring a speech by Sister Souljah, who has shown through her music she is intolerant of other races. Sent in by a student who thinks JMU is better off without speakers with intolerant attitudes.

An "excellent-job" pat to the Pi Kappa Phi and Alpha Kappa Lambda fraternities for their community service projects for the Harrisonburg Parks and Recreation Department. Sent in by a Harrisonburg Recreation employee who has less to worry about because of all their help.
target: the Pi Kappa Phi and Alpha Kappa Lambda fraternities

text: A "could-you-be-more-disrespectful?" dart to the people who left my apartment a wreck after the party I had Saturday night. Sent in by someone who thinks having a party doesn't give anyone the right to trash his place.

A "thanks-for-all-your-hard-work" pat to the incredible women at the Women's Resource Center. The month of events you planned around Women's Celebration Month have been inspiring. Congratulations on a successful year. Sent in by your friends at FYI who see how much work you do to further the cause for women at JMU.

A "your-sarcasm-wasn't-funny" dart to the guy who stole my organic chemistry book from the library last week and after seeing my name and phone number written inside, called me and asked, "So, how are you doing in chemistry?" Sent in by a disgusted student who can't afford to buy a new book and wants hers returned.

A "fearless-leader" pat to Kim Dyle for her constant enthusiasm and unyielding commitment to Recycling Awareness Week. She is truly amazing. Sent in by the Health 458 class that appreciates a great leader. Please recycle this Breeze.

A "thanks-a-lot-you-drunken-thieves" dart to the people who drank our beer and then proceeded to steal CDs and an expensive camera from our party. Sent in by two students who want back what rightfully belongs to them.

A "thanks-for-the-dining-dollars" pat to the Dukes cashier who paid for my ice cream with his own JAC card after I forgot mine. Sent in by a student who knows the value of dining dollars and appreciates the kind gesture.

A "we-wish-you-hadn't-had-a-ticket" dart to the guy who heckled Mario Joyner at the Chris Rock show Tuesday night. Sent in by students who think you obviously don't appreciate good humor and, with that attitude, you might as well have stayed home.

An "angels-in-disguise" pat to Kelley K. and the guy in the cream Volvo. Thanks for giving me a jump on a cold, rainy day. Sent in by a student who is grateful for their assistance but learned a lesson and invested in jumper cables.

A "we-already-have-alarm-clocks-thank-you" dart to SGA for approving chimes for Wilson Hall without considering residence halls on the Quad. Sent in by someone who wishes JMU could establish tradition a little more quietly so she can sleep.
A "way-to-go" pat to Alyson Clark for getting the assistant Greek coordinator position. You deserve it, and we're so proud of you. Sent in by the members of Alpha Chi Omega sorority.

A "thanks-for-being-so-inconsiderate" dart to the Valley Mall Cinema. The end of "The Devil's Own" got blacked out, but when we informed you of the problem we were brushed aside. Sent in by two disgruntled students who want to warn people not to see this movie at the Valley Mall if they want to know how it ends.

An "I-wish-there-were-more-people-like-you" pat to the students who work at the Information Desk in Warren Hall. Every time I need help, you're there with a cheerful smile and a sense of humor. Sent in by a student who appreciates the assistance and the courtesy.

A "what-were-you-thinking?" dart to the middle education department for not keeping Sandy Dutemple. She will be missed by all her students. Sent in by a student who thinks the line to get into Dutemple's office is reason enough to keep her.

A "thank-you-for-sharing-your-talent" pat to Kat Hale who volunteered her time and heart to paint a mural for the Women's Resource Center. Sent in by the Women's Resource Center staff with great appreciation.

A "where-are-we-supposed-to-wipe-our-sweat-on?" dart to UREC for never having any towels out. Sent in by a student who's sick of using her T-shirt as a sweat rag and wonders why UREC is hoarding the towels.

A "thanks-a-million" pat to Michelle Davis at Hair Plus in the Valley Mall. She is the best hair stylist in the 'Burg. Sent in by an appreciative senior who would have been looking like Cousin It from the Addams Family if not for her skills.

A "you're-all-cowards" dart to the people at Hunter's Ridge who sat and watched while an innocent guy got his face kicked in. Sent in by someone who hopes you are not there if he's ever getting beat up.

A "we-love-downtown" pat to EARTH and all the other organizations for bringing the JMU and Harrisonburg communities together through the Support Downtown Festival Saturday. You did a great job. Sent in by someone who appreciates their efforts and respects the community she'll only stay in for four years.
target: EARTH and all the other organizations

text: An "I-really-need-my-research-back" dart to the person who stole my backpack from outside of PC Dukes Thursday night. My final grade depends on the notes and textbook in that backpack. Please return it to the lost and found. Sent in by a student who will fail his music industry class if his backpack isn't returned.

A "you're-a-lifesaver" pat to the JMU Alumni Association for sending out a checklist of events to graduating seniors. Sent in by a student who was a bit confused about the graduation process and was helped a great deal by your list.
A "what-was-up-with-the-lights" dart to whomever was in charge of lighting at Greek Sing Thursday. Sent in by a student who preferred to actually see the first few performances.

A "you-are-the-dog" pat to the Duke Dog for doing such a great job and coming in third in the national mascot competition. Sent in by a dog lover who knows the heart you put into it and the sweat you have to endure to be as good as you are.

A "charred-and-smoldering" dart to the staff in Wampler Hall for almost burning the place down last Sunday and then lying to the residents about what really happened. Sent in by a resident who now wonders how well-trained the staff really is.

A "thanks-for-helping-out" pat to the guys in the brick house across from Citgo/Dairy Queen who helped my mom out when her car died in the middle of Port Republic Road. Sent in by an appreciative Eastern Mennonite student whose mom is now thinking of baking you guys cookies.

A "very-unprofessional" dart to the owner and manager of JM's who called us liars and cussed us out when we simply called to ask why our food never came. Sent in by a group of students who used to think JM's was a good place to call to order late-night food.
A "we-are-so-proud-of-you" pat to Mindy Fisher for receiving the honor of Greek Woman of the Year. Sent in by the pride-filled members of Sigma Kappa sorority.

A "drown-in-your-sweat" dart to the girl who complained about the lack of towels at UREC. Over 400 towels have been stolen since the facility opened. You should complain to the towel thieves, not UREC. Sent in by a UREC employee who is happy to have people use the 45 remaining towels but is incapable of creating more.
A "thanks-for-the-dough" pat to the guy in the copy center who gave me 20 cents. Sent in by a student who was able to finish her homework because of him.

An "I-don't-want-to-be-roadkill" dart to the jerk in the black Firebird who almost ran me over in the Olde Mill parking lot. Sent in by an Olde Mill resident who thinks he remembers hearing somewhere that pedestrians have the right of way.
A "you're-the-best" pat to Phyllis the cleaning lady for cleaning our very messy suite. We appreciate everything you do for us. Sent in by the second floor C Wing of Shorts Hall.

A "shut-up" dart to the two girls working at the Reserves Desk Friday night. Your loud talking and singing didn't help my studying much. Sent in by a student who tried to get work done but, thanks to you, didn't have much success.
A "congratulations" pat to Jacqueline Nathaniel for making captain of the Dukettes for next year. Sent in by a friend who realizes your talent, time and hard work are starting to pay off.

A "thanks-for-the-warning" dart to the English department for not telling students of the changes made in technical writing courses for next semester. Sent in by a student who would have appreciated knowing she was going to have to take very different classes.
A "you-rock" pat to Missy Weiss for getting the assistant Greek coordinator position. Sent in by the members of Zeta Tau Alpha sorority who are proud of their Jersey girl.

A "totally-inconsiderate" dart to the JMU parking division for thinking a Food Services convention was more important than students being able to get to class at CISAT on time. Sent in by a student who would appreciate prior warning the next time they take away student parking in the Convo lot.

A "great-job" pat to Seth Lieberman for making a memorable Holocaust Remembrance Day. You did a magnificent job in your coordination of the events, despite many obstacles. Sent in by the Hillel Counselorship and everyone else who gained from your hard work.
sender: the Hillel Counselorship and everyone else

text: A "we-deserve-some-credit" dart to the campus cadets' coordinator for not nominating any campus cadets for Student Employee of the Year. Sent in by a hard-working cadet who thinks someone should have been recognized.

A "you're-amazing" pat to the Outrigger Peer Educators for being such a wonderful group of people. You really shined at the Leadership Awards Banquet. Sent in by one of your biggest fans who aspires to be part of your group someday.

A "find-something-better-to-do-with-your-time" dart to the parking staff members giving each other high fives while writing parking tickets. Sent in by someone who doesn't like watching you gloat while taking our money.
A "we-wish-you-a-happy-birthday" pat to Kelly W. May all your wishes come true. Sent in by two friends who feel fortunate to have met you this year.

A "are-you-trying-to-promote-lying" dart to the administration for not allowing Honor Council to inform students about the Honor System at orientation this summer. Sent in by a student who wishes the administration put a higher value on the Honor Code.

A "you-will-be-missed" pat to senior cheerleaders Kim Shuford, Laura Ridolphi, Jennifer Marnane, Ron Farrington, Mike Rogers, Brian Rivero and Chris Traczyk. Thanks for all your hard work and dedication. Good luck! Sent in by a coach that hates to see such a fine group leave JMU.

A "get-all-the-information-before-you-speak" dart to the guest columnist who called Student Ambassadors "poor" and "innocent." Sent in by a Student Ambassador who knows ambassadors are hiding nothing and are trained to give accurate information.

A "job-well-done" pat to the JMU Upgrade Telefund Team for raising $682,000 toward students' academic and athletic needs. You've really made a difference. Sent in by a huge fan who knows the value of that hard work.

A "get-your-act-together" dart to a local apartment complex for being dirty, disorganized and unprepared for this year's residents to move in. Sent in by an angry resident who did not appreciate seeing the building in the same condition it was in last spring.

A "thanks-for-the-roadside-assistance" pat to Joe at Exxon for helping me with my very flat tire. Sent in by a car-trouble-laden student who wishes her vehicle would warn her before having problems, but is glad you were there to lend a hand.

A "did-you-think-we-wouldn't-notice" dart to Vending Services for raising the prices of food and drinks in campus vending machines. Sent in by a poor student who can't afford a soda and a candy bar now.
A "we-all-scream-for-ice-cream" pat to Campus Police for giving free ice cream to people who registered their vehicles. Sent in by a grateful student who wishes to give props to the cops.
A "give-us-back-our-streets" dart to JMU for closing Bluestone Drive without any notice. Sent in by a student who had to go out of her way and would have liked some warning.

An "eternal-gratitude" pat to all the people who helped convert the Delta Sigma Pi house into livable condition. Your endless hours of toil are much appreciated. Sent in by residents who are happy not to have to sleep in beer sludge anymore.
A "where-are-your-manners" dart to people who try to steal parking spaces others have been waiting for. Sent in by a commuter who wishes your mama had taught you better manners.
A "job-well-done" pat to UPB for organizing the showing of "Ferris Bueller's Day Off" outside Grafton-Stovall. Sent in by a student who forgot how much fun on-campus events can be.

A "what-did-you-think-we-were-standing-there-for" dart to the girl who thought she could go to the front of the line in Market One despite the other people waiting their turn. Sent in by a student who wants to know where you got your nerve.
A "good-samaritan" pat to the man who picked up a guy on crutches Tuesday and drove him home. Sent in by a student who witnessed your act of kindness and was moved even though it wasn't toward her.
A "how-do-we-find-class" dart to CISAT for not indicating the names of its buildings on the outside. Sent in by a student who is not psychic and can't find her classes without sufficient direction.

A "thanks-for-the-tip" pat to the girl who came and informed my English class that the class location had been changed. Sent in by a student whose class would have sat in Keezell for hours had it not been for you.

A "my-room-is-not-your-trash-pit" dart to the girls who live on my floor who dump their trash in my room and leave. Sent in by a student who loves living with you but wants you to put your trash in your own rooms.

A "you-saved-my-life" pat to the girl at a party Thursday night who told me where to find my lost JAC card. Sent in by a grateful student who didn't have the money for a new one and was very glad you helped her out.

An "I-took-a-shower-before-I-left" dart to Grounds Services for putting sprinklers in front of the houses on Greek Row. Sent in by a student who's glad the grass will grow but doesn't appreciate walking to class wet.

A "what-a-gentleman" pat to the Sigma Alpha Epsilon brother who got rid of the mouse that had been in our house for days. Sent in by extremely grateful Sigma Kappas who now live in a mouse-free environment.

A "you-can't-possibly-appreciate-my-pain" dart to whoever's bright idea it was to put gravel on the street by the Quad. Sent in by a student who wishes you would have considered how much it hurts when one of those pebbles gets into your shoe.
A "thanks-for-the-ride" pat to the group of guys who drove me and a friend home after our supposed designated driver left us. Sent in by students who would have had to walk home otherwise.

An "it's-time-to-play-the-quiet-game" dart to the freshmen who decided to get in touch with their inner child by playing capture the flag on the Quad at 2:30 a.m. Sent in by a crybaby Bluestone resident who should know if you can't beat 'em, join 'em.
A "thanks-for-your-time" pat to all the organizations who came out for Student Organization Night. Sent in by a student who thinks you all represented your organizations well.
An "it's-less-than-perfect" dart to Computing Services for removing WordPerfect from every computer on campus. Sent in by a student who hates Microsoft Word and is sure he's not alone.

A "thanks-for-your-help" pat to Tau Kappa Epsilon brothers who helped me move in without my having to ask. Sent in by a freshman who needed all the help she could get and appreciated the extra assistance.

A "how-long-do-I-have-to-wait" dart to my apartment complex for still not fixing my screen after three weeks of waiting. Sent in by a student who lives on the first floor and wants the screen fixed before people start taking his stuff.
A "way-to-throw-a-party" pat to the Rangers for showing freshmen what partying in college is really about. Sent in by a student who had a great time and can't wait to party with you again.

An "I-might-as-well-eat-at-D-hall" dart to Mrs. Green's for its pathetic lettuce supply. Sent in by a student who counted on you, unlike every other place on campus, for fresh, green lettuce and is very upset you let her down.

A "thanks-for-the-generosity" pat to the girl who took me all the way home to Blueridge Hall last Sunday at 3 a.m. Sent in by a grateful student who probably would have been picked up by the police otherwise.

A "how-are-we-supposed-to-get-home" dart to Harrisonburg Transit for only having two buses that go from campus to Southview apartments. Sent in by a student who doesn't want to be stranded on campus just because he doesn't live in Hunter's Ridge.
A "thanks-for-caring" pat to the management of the Commons for getting me a new mattress when my old one had the springs sticking out. Sent in by a student who will sleep much better at night now.

A "watch-where-you're-going" dart to the clutz who spilled an entire beer — cup and all — down my shirt Saturday night. Sent in by a student who didn't appreciate walking around reeking of Milwaukee's Best all night.

A "you-guys-are-amazing" pat to Gena Bonsiero and Casey Hanner for all your time and hard work planning Sigma Kappa's rush. Sent in by your sorority sisters who appreciate everything you've done to make this year's rush a success.

A "does-my-car-look-like-an-ashtray" dart to the Harrisonburg Transit driver who threw his cigarette in my sunroof because he thought I was driving too slow. Sent in by a student who didn't appreciate a burn hole in her car and will be wary of opening her sunroof from now on.
A "good-old-boys" pat to the brothers of Kappa Alpha for throwing parties without making it feel like a meat market. Sent in by a student who enjoyed the more laid-back atmosphere.

A "move-the-herd-along" dart to all the freshmen who think they are cool traveling in packs of 50 to parties and holding up traffic. Sent in by a student who has road rage and won't be so patient in the future.
A "thanks-so-much" pat to the guy cheerleader who carried me home after I sprained my ankle. Sent in by a student who appreciated the kind gesture.

A "thanks-for-confirming-my-opinion" dart to the sorority girls who were sitting in D-hall openly complaining about the girls involved in this year's rush. Sent in by a student who thinks getting into a sorority shouldn't rely solely on a girl's looks and wealth.

A "you-guys-are-great" pat to the Chi Phi brothers I watched movies with Sunday night. You cheered me up a lot, whether you know it or not. Sent in by a student who thanks you for making a difficult situation easier for her to handle.
A "take-some-Vivarin" dart to my anthropology teaching assistant who falls asleep in class every day. Sent in by two students who wonder how well you can help them if you doze through class.

A "we-appreciate-all-you-do" pat to JMU Housekeeping staff for its year-round dedication to making our campus a clean place to live and work. Sent in by a faculty member in recognition of National Housekeeping Week.

A "we-don't-live-at-the-dump" dart to a local apartment complex for not having trash dumpsters emptied on a regular basis. Sent in by a renter who doesn't appreciate the stench and the rodents the trash is attracting.

A "thanks-for-making-me-aware" pat to Theta Chi fraternity for sponsoring Mike Green's "Four Stages of Drinking" program last Monday. Sent in by a student who thinks if all fraternities took similar views on drinking, the Greek system would get a better rap.

A "you're-a-Sigma-Kappa-and-I'm-glad-I'm-not" dart to Sigma Kappa sorority for its tasteless bid celebration shirts. Sent in by a student who's glad the other seven sororities have a little more class.

A "thanks-for-your-kindness" pat to Harrisonburg Police officers who were so nice, even though they broke up my party last weekend. Sent in by a student who was upset about his party getting busted but was glad you were so friendly about it.
A "find-a-toilet" dart to the guy who threw up all over my new pants last weekend. Sent in by a student who did not need to know what he had for dinner that night.

A "thanks-for-your-common-courtesy" pat to the guy who didn't allow his friend to steal a parking space in the gravel pit that was rightfully mine. Sent in by a student who thanks you for not advocating parking space theft.

A "please-be-mature" dart to all the people making a bigger deal than necessary over Sigma Kappa's bid celebration T-shirts. Sent in by a student who believes there are other issues on campus more worthy of thought and discussion than a T-shirt.
A "thanks-for-making-us-civilized" pat to the construction company planning to build a road to my apartment complex. Sent in by a resident who will no longer have to go off-roading to get home.

A "back-of-the-line-buddy" dart to the girl in the Ford who thought she could go to the front of the line of cars waiting to park in the gravel pit. Sent in by a faculty member who thinks you should have learned in kindergarten not to cut in line.
A "you're-cool" pat to the Vending Services man who gave me a free drink while he reloaded the machines in Godwin. Sent in by a student who appreciated saving 60 cents.

A "clean-up-after-yourself" dart to the person who spilled chocolate milk on the steps of Mrs. Green's. Your laziness and disregard made me slip and fall down the entire flight of steps. Sent in by an embarrassed student who has bruises and a sprained ankle to remind her of your messiness.

A "jobs-well-done" pat to The Breeze's editorial and web design staff for putting together an informative, thought-provoking and entertaining paper and web site. Sent in by a reader who thinks you should be proud of what you do.
target: The Breeze's editorial and web design staff

text: A "beep-this" dart to the JMU Maintenance truck drivers who feel the need to make so much noise backing up outside of residence halls at random hours of the night. Sent in by a sleep-deprived student who doesn't enjoy waking up five times a night.
A "way-to-go" pat to the baseball team for keeping their heads up and working hard after all they've been through. Sent in by a die-hard fan.
A "do-you-know-what-time-it-is?" dart to the Marching Royal Dukes for practicing at the crack of dawn Saturday morning. Sent in by a student who would rather sleep than listen to "Virginia's Finest."

A "thanks-for-understanding" pat to the campus cadet who let my friends take me home to bed rather than give me a drunk in public charge. Sent in by a student who has you to thank for not being in today's Police Log
A "what-happened-to-my-song?" dart to PC Dukes for having a broken jukebox that takes your money but won't play your song. Sent in by a student who wants to hear the music he paid for.

A "we're-glad-to-work-with-you-no-matter-what-time-it-is" pat to the Marching Royal Dukes. We wish everyone appreciated your hard work, talent and dedication as much as we do. Sent in by the Dukettes who love to perform at half-time with you and think you should get the credit you deserve.

A "your-aim-sucks" dart to the disgusting guy who tried spitting out the window of a bus last week. I got a very unappreciated shower. Sent in by a student who thinks you could use some target practice before you try spitting again.

A "you-saved-us-from-starvation" pat to Jon Judah of Alpha Kappa Lambda, who generously bought us lunch when we were experiencing JAC card difficulties at Door 4. We were overwhelmed by your kindness to two complete strangers. Sent in by two Sigma Kappas who hope to someday return the favor.

A "where's-my-discount?" dart to JMU Dining Services for not giving students their five percent discount when they make a purchase with flex. Sent in by a penny-pinching student who needs every penny he can save.

A "way-to-go" pat to the JMU cheerleaders and the Duke Dog for doing such a great job cheering on the Dukes in the rain Saturday. Sent in by a student who commends you for sticking it out like the true athletes you are.
target: the JMU cheerleaders and the Duke Dog

text: A "where-are-we-supposed-to-sit?" dart to the people who stole the lounge chairs in the Wampler study lounge for their own personal uses. Sent in by a Wampler resident who doesn't want to study on the floor.
A "helluva-performance" pat to the readers, open mikers and solo guitarist at last Monday's gardy loo! reading. Sent in by a gardy loo! editor who enjoyed hearing your work.
target: the readers, open milkers and solo guitarist

text: A "you-know-who-you-are" dart to the person who stole my beer and my backpack at Melrose Friday night. Sent in by a student who spent hard-earned money and didn't appreciate your thieving ways.
A "thanks-a-lot" pat to the Campus Cadets who walked me to my car from UREC late Sunday night without my having to ask. Sent in by a student who appreciates your dedication to helping others.

A "you're-showing-your-ignorance" dart to the person who covered the word "not" on a flier for the Rape Is Not Sex lecture. Sent in by a student who thinks you should attend the lecture and learn something.
A "you-rock" pat to my friend who got us both out of a ticket Saturday with some smooth talking and a lot of tears. Sent in by a student who won't have a court date thanks to you.
A "hire-more-help" dart to Campus Postal Services for taking so long to distribute campus mail. Sent in by a student who waited three weeks before she finally received a letter she'd been expecting.

A "you-guys-are-awesome" pat to the brothers of Sigma Chi for supporting Mercy House and bringing the Greek community together with Derby Days. Sent in by Alpha Phis who appreciate all the hard work you've put in.
An "it's-not-the-same" dart to PC Dukes for replacing Mello Yello with Surge. Sent in by a student who can tell the difference and likes Mello Yello better.
A "thanks-for-the-jump" pat to the graduate student who started my car Sunday night in the rain. Sent in by a student who was able to drive home because of you.

A "thanks-a-lot" dart to the girl who was supposed to give me a ride home Tuesday night but left me waiting at Zane Showker and never showed up. Sent in by a student who had to walk all the way to Southview and is going to remember that the next time you need a ride anywhere.

A "special-thank-you" pat to all who participated in Thursday's blood drive. The donors, American Red Cross staff and the brothers of Alpha Kappa Psi all helped make it a success. Sent in by an Alpha Kappa Psi member who appreciates all your effort and support.

A "thanks-for-wasting-my-time" dart to Market One for taking too long to make the wrong steak sub too many times. Sent in by three students who have better things to do than wait 20 minutes for their food.

An "apology-accepted" pat to the guy who tripped and fell on me last Monday night in the crowd at Taylor Hall, and then gave me a carnation to make amends. Sent in by a student who appreciated the sweet gesture and wants you to know she's OK.

A "you-don't-own-the-Eagle-Hall-elevator" dart to a certain seventh-floor resident who rudely told me to take the stairs next time to my back as I got off the elevator. A "thanks-for-raising-out-of-state-tuition" dart to JMU. At this rate in a couple of years you will no longer have any out-of-state students. Sent in by ticked-off out-of-state students trying to keep it real.

A "way-to-carry-on-the-AIDS-Walk-tradition" pat to the sisters of Alpha Sigma Tau for their excellent work this weekend. Sent in by a proud AST alumna who was an undergrad when the AIDS Walk began at JMU.

An "AIDS-is-not-a-joke" dart to the five AST women who talked and laughed through the AIDS Walk speakers and prayer Saturday. Sent in by an embarrassed Greek who thinks that if you're going to be rude at your own fund-raiser, you shouldn't wear your sorority letters across your chest.

A "thanks-for-brightening-my-day-with-your-yellow-tie-and-appreciation-of-oldies-music" pat to the person who rocked out to our parents' classics on the bus the other day. Sent in by a girl who thought she was the only one who knew the words.

A "we-were-going-to-eat-that" dart to JMU Dining Services for closing the dining halls this past week almost as if it was some kind of holiday break, even though we got no days of classes off. Sent in by two freshmen guys who might not be here next year, not only because of the recent tuition hikes, but because we are now having food taken out of our mouths.

A "way-to-be-a-royal-slacker" dart to a certain JMU employee who decided to sunbathe in Virginia Beach instead of coming into work on Friday. Sent in by your fellow co-workers who had to pick up your slack that day and hope you got burned.

A "you-make-our-organization-reach-new-heights" pat to all of the sport club presidents, council representatives and executive members for their hard work and dedication this year. Sent in by an advisor who truly values and appreciates fantastic student leaders like you.
target: all of the sport club presidents

text: A "San-Diego-isn't-ready-for-us" pat to the Body For Life participants who just finished the 12-week program. Sent in by a fellow BFL-er who congratulates your athletic and culinary discipline and determination.

A "learn-how-to-share-and-care" dart to the professor who threw a group of girls out of the dance room because we are not dance majors who spend our time standing like trees. Sent in by an annoyed senior who thinks we pay enough tuition to be able to use the Godwin dance room for an hour.

A "way-to-shake-your-boogie" pat to the two guys who braved Zane Showker in nothing but extra-small JMU work-out shorts to cheer on a tour. Sent in by two sophomores who think there's no better way to catch new students than to show some leg.
A "way-to-be-student-friendly" dart to the University Health Center. Sent in by a sick student who doesn't plan her sickness around business hours.

A "thanks-for-giving-us-hope" pat to a certain opinion writer for his article on love that made us realize there are still a few decent guys out there. Sent in by some freshman girls who agree with you and wonder why they can't find guys who feel the same way.
A "get-a-room" dart to the naked couple getting it on in the Keezell elevator Saturday. Sent in by someone who's going to take the stairs from now on.

An "I'm-sure-glad-I-was-watching-out-for-landmines" pat to the individuals who organized and executed Landmine Awareness Week. Sent in by a senior who can't wait to read the news that the landmine problem is cured because JMU students are now aware of them and because of your efforts is even more so looking forward to Pothole Awareness Week.

An "I-know-where-I'm-not-living-next-year" dart to a certain apartment complex for enforcing seven-days-a-week towing because of lack of parking for residents and then further increasing the problem by making two spaces from every building handicap. Sent in by an annoyed resident who thinks that if your goal is to make the buildings more handicap-accessible you should start drawing up your plans to put in elevators.

A "thank-you-for-all-your-hard-work" pat to all of the MACRoCk staff who worked double-overtime this weekend. From a WXJM-er who was super-impressed with how smoothly everything ran and loves Harrisonburg's independent rock 'n' roll in the ’Burg.

A "way-to-rub-it-in" dart to whomever came up with the idea to advertise the showing of "Schindler's List" on little flames all over the Commons. Sent in by someone who thinks what happened in World War II is bad enough without advertising a historical Holocaust movie on pieces of fire.

A "get-a-Tic-Tac" dart to the mouth-breather with butt-breath that sat next to me in anthropology class Tuesday morning. Sent in by a stressed-out junior who could tell that you were not sick (and therefore had no business mouth-breathing) and spent over an hour fighting off your skank breath instead of concentrating on the class lecture that she desperately needed to focus on.

A "thanks-for-not-hating-me-even-though-I-never-listen-and-always-eat-your-pickles" pat to my roommate who is appreciated more than she knows. Sent in by a junior who appreciates you with or without your Super Nintendo.

A "way-to-help-a-girl-out" pat to the art department for helping me finally declare my art major and get my classes on time. Sent in by a girl who thinks it's a relief to see that the teachers and faculty really do care about the students.

A "way-to-show-the-apathy-toward-JMU-students" dart to the student in Monday's Breeze who decided to share his discovery that cynicism is easier than trying to make a difference. Way to make a stand against the anti-landmine group. From a student who realizes that no matter what side of the political spectrum you come from (including apathy) a healthy dose of idealism and empathy is nothing to be ashamed of.

A "my-kind-of-man" pat to the guy in Warren Hall who not only held the door for me but then struck up a very friendly conversation. Sent in by a freshman girl who was sorry you disappeared when she turned her back but appreciative for the reminder that guys like you are still around.

An "I-work-for-a-reason" dart to those JMU students who have omitted the word "tip" from their mental vocabulary. From a bartender who makes less than minimum wage so relies on tips and will make sure your drinks are extra long next time you order them.

A "now-that-you-destroyed-the-good-ones-don't-forget-the-old-ones" dart to whoever decided that April 11 is too early to activate the tennis court lights. Sent in by an avid tennis fan who already is embarrassed by the poor condition of what courts are left after some were given up at the expense of a few parking spaces.

A "thanks-for-making-a-beautiful-day-even-better" pat to the guy in the speedo who tanned on the marching band field in front of Hillside Hall Thursday. Sent in by the smiling girls of Hillside who really enjoyed looking out their windows.

A "thanks-for-not-reciprocating" pat to the guy who I nailed in the face with my purse as he was jogging by the other night. Sent in by a girl who apologizes profusely that she actually hit you while making fun of herself for almost hitting another runner about five seconds before and hopes that it didn't hurt too much.

A "way-to-show-bad-taste-and-turn-a-tragedy-into-an-inconsiderate-skit" dart to a certain sorority that portrayed Sept. 11 in its Greek Sing skit. Sent in by a New Yorker who was devastated by Sept. 11 and who knows many victims and did not think it was appropriate.
A "you-win-snuggler-of-the-year" pat to my boyfriend for staying home with me on Saturday night just to cuddle. Sent in by a sophomore girl who is so glad to have such a great guy.

A "you-being-off-schedule-affects-us-more-than-you-know" dart to the bus drivers who are either early, late or non-existent recently. Sent in by a stranded sophomore who hopes that you will at least be on time during finals week.

A "thanks-for-urinating-in-my-bed-and-not-leaving-until-three-in-the-afternoon" dart to the townie that had a sleepover at my place this weekend. Sent in by a junior who's looking for love in all the wrong places.

An "au-revoir-merci-and-good-luck" pat to JMU's graduating A-Fashion Nado. You brought many vigorous laughs to this middle-aged woman. Thank you and the very best to you in your future pursuits. Sent in by a JMU employee, a descendent of ’70s bell-bottoms, hip-huggers and (gasp!) Ditto jeans.

A "you-made-our-walk-home-so-much-more-fun" pat to the two guys who stopped and joined our "red light, green light" game on the walk back from a party. Sent in by two sophomore girls who are so proud you knew all the rules.

An "it's-easy-to-be-condescending-and-dismissive-when-the-rats-aren't-in-your-backyard" dart to the members of the school administration who have been less than helpful with the Newman Lake problem. Sent in by some of us living by the lake who think dangerous or not, the rats are still pests and something needs to be done about them.

A "you-guys-rule" pat to the muskrats in Newman Lake. Way to go about your lives even though some sorority girls have problems cohabitating with peaceful creatures that do plenty of good and no harm. From a sophomore who lives on Greek Row and thinks the animals in the lake are just trying to survive like everyone else.

A "this-is-not-home" dart to the inconsiderate guy who decided to take up a table, three chairs, a couch and several feet of floor space for his junk and himself at an already overcrowded Taylor Down Under at lunch time. Sent in by an irate junior who really hopes that you learn something about manners.

A "why'd-you-keep-Timmy-and-Dan-a-secret?" dart to the University Program Board for failing to advertise the "Road Rules"-ers' speaking appearance on Monday night. From an avid and disappointed "Road Rules" fan who thinks that if you're going to invite people to speak then you should inform the students of it better.
sender: an avid and disappointed "Road Rules" fan

text: An "I-don't-think-you'll-ever-really-convince-me" pat right on the tooshie to the excellent masseur who tried to convince me that sleeping naked is a fair and natural expression. Sent in by a senior who wants you to know that she never will be convinced that slumbering in her birthday suit is the comfiest thing there is.

A "congratulations-for-a-job-well-done" pat to the Dukettes for their accomplishments in Daytona. Sent in by a trumpet player who is proud of your squad and would like to thank you for four years of award-winning dancing.

A "wait-in-line-like-everyone-else" dart to the Corolla-driving princess who drove around me to steal the spot I was waiting on and next in line for. From a student who thinks that next time you should wear your tiara so everyone knows royalty is coming through to usurp our spots.
A "you-roll" pat to the "Danga-Blada's" roller hockey team of Forest Hills for all of your hard work at practice this past year. Sent in by your dedicated captain who loves you all very much.

A "that-was-nacho-cheese" dart to the Wayland Hall resident that stole my salsa con queso from the first-floor fridge this weekend. Sent in by a sophomore whose chips just don't taste the same without that delicious dipping sauce.

A "hope-your-foot-feels-better-soon" pat to the guy whose foot apparently was run over outside my apartment Saturday night. Sent in by someone who was trying (unsuccessfully) to sleep, overheard the whole thing and thinks you deserve better for keeping your friend from driving home drunk.

A "you-are-not-the-only-faith-on-campus" dart to Everystudent.com for not being for every student. Sent in by a sophomore who knows she is in the minority but doesn't appreciate you making it seem even worse.
A "the-eight-ball-says-yes" pat to my mentor and friend who will succeed in life, love and career after graduation. From a fledgling mother duck who knows she has big flip-flops to fill.

An "I-hope-the-sharks-aren't-feeding-on-thieves-this-summer" dart to the winner who stole the surfboard pads off of the racks on my car this weekend. Sent in by a sophomore who's sure he's a better surfer than you and isn't sweating it.
A "you''ve-got-style" pat to the guy who tipped $3 on a $5 meal at RT's Chicken and Grill. Sent in by a senior who works har for her money and appreciated the gesture.

A "you-make-me-want-to-bang-my-head-against-the-wall" dart to the JMU server for crashing every year when we were trying to register our computers. Sent in by a senior who spent hours waiting for the registration process to finally complete successfully.

A "you-got-me-through-the-hard-times" pat to my Orientation Map-ease for leading me around campus these past few days. Sent in by a freshman who was so glad to have so many informational materials distributed to him throughout the orientation process.

A "what-were-you-thinking?" dart to Carrier Library for providing only one defunct copy machine on the reference level of the Library. Sent in by a group of doctoral students who are spending a lot of money on copies for their dissertations and don't have the time nor the patience to carry around stacks of journals in search of a copier.
A "special-delivery" pat to my chef-like roommates who brought me homemade dinner and dessert at work. Sent in by a taxed and tired workaholic with a weakness for buffalo pizza and apple crisp.

A "way-to-not-recognize-your-own-parking-permits" dart to the idiot in parking services who gave me a $100 ticket for an invalid permit which was issued to me by Parking Services. Sent in by an extremely pissed-off senior who has your officer ID and can find out who you are.

A "get-over-it" dart to the drama-queen of a junior who acted like a seventh-grader when she switched groups to get out of being with me. From another junior and her friends who think you should grow up and get on with your life.

A "way-to-stay-on-the-straight-and-narrow" pat to the JMU grounds crew for sticking to Virginia water regulations. Sent in by a group of seniors who are pleased to see the Quad browning out if it keeps us hydrated.

A "you're-right-on-key" pat for the great group of girls from Note-oriety for taking me out for ice cream even though I can't sing. Sent in by a junior who will make sure she gets a front-row seat at your next performance.

An "obnoxious-doesn't-even-cover-it" dart to the girl who persisted in beeping at me, not once but twice, for letting other cars who were stuck at that awful Forest Hills intersection go before me. Sent in by a northern girl who came to Virginia for the friendly faces, not the rude, ignorant bad drivers like you.

A "you-jump-start-my-engine" pat to the three fabulous freshman boys who helped me start my car on a rainy night. From a silly junior who left her lights on again and was two steps from walking home in the rain if it wasn't for your kind rescue.

A "has-anyone-ever-heard-of-breakfast" dart to the bright ones of Dining Services who choose not to serve food between 10 and 11 a.m. Sent in by a student who needs to eat breakfast before class and this is the only time.

A "you've-got-a-lot-of-class" pat to all the teachers that gave me overrides this semester. Sent in by a senior who can't believe she still needs to get them but is glad she has found teachers to grant them.

A "thanks-for-stealing-all-my-good-parking-spots" dart to JMU parking services for converting all of the student motorcycle spots into faculty-only spots. From a disgruntled senior motorcycle rider who enjoyed being able to park directly in front of Zane Showker Hall for the past three years.

A "thanks-for-showing-the-JMU-spirit-of-friendliness" pat to the cute gentleman who generously lent me change in Zane Showker for my soft pretzel. Sent in by a junior who has been reminded what a great school she attends where random acts of kindness are the norm.

A "there-is-a-limit" dart to The Breeze for allowing itself to be an output for religious rhetoric and intolerance. Sent in by an upset reader who is waiting for The Breeze to print some classic Hitler speeches.

A "thanks-for-teaching-me-a-lesson" pat to the guy with the New York tags who helped me feel very guilty after I rudely stole his parking spot. From a girl who is never usually that rude and can't believe she behaved the way she did.

A "Trading-Spaces'-you-are-not" dart to the boys who took all our suite furniture and set it up outside in the courtyard for us to find. Sent in by a group of freshman girls who are already planning their revenge.

A "you're-my-secret-citrus-garden" pat to the vending machine in Harrison Hall with Diet Mountain Dew. Sent in by a senior who's glad to know that through all the summer changes, the important things stay the same.

A "go-buy-some-spackle-and-some-new-friends" dart to my roommate for introducing me to the guy I liked and then hooking up with him that same night. Sent in by your ex-friend with a sore foot from the hole she kicked in the wall that night.

A "you-keep-me-on-the-move" pat to all the regular early-morning runners that keep the streets of Harrisonburg well-worn. Sent in by a senior who loves to see people who love running as much as she does.

A "there-are-other-hours-in-the-day" dart to the garbage trucks that insist upon emptying the dumpster right outside of our window only during the hours of 12 to 7 a.m. Sent in by two sophomores who don't need their alarm clocks anymore.

A "you-made-my-day" pat to the nicest girl ever for finding my cell phone at the bus stop and going way out of her way to get it back to me. Sent in by a student who is relieved that people really do care.

A "with-your-attitude-and-intelligence-level-you'll-never-get-a-job" dart to the very loud and obnoxious CIS major who felt the need to publicly insult a professional organization that other people have put a lot of effort into. From a fellow CIS major who has watched you behave like a moron for the last three years and wonders if you have any class at all.
target: the very loud and obnoxious CIS major

text: A "way-to-be-open-minded" dart to the individual who darted The Breeze for allowing a student to express his religious views. Sent in by a student who feels that all beliefs and ideas, even offensive or controversial ones, deserve a forum for expression.
A "whatchu-talkin'- 'bout-Willis" pat to my homeboy DeBo for finding that hot chick I went out with the other night. From a pimped-out playa who needed some direction.

A "thanks-for-showing-me-that-JMU-has-some-really-sweet-caring-guys" pat to the senior hockey player who gave a stranded girl a ride home at 4 a.m. Sent in by a grateful sophomore who now has another reason to go to JMU hockey games.

A "lack-of-patriotism" dart to the JMU administration for not canceling class on Labor Day and Sept. 11. Sent in by some students who would like the opportunity to observe those days and are disappointed that you do not feel the same.

A "thanks-for-your-generosity-and-thinking-of-others" pat to the girl at Festival who put more money into my meter to help me avoid getting a ticket from Parking Services. Sent in by a junior who always seems to be in a rush and who appreciates your random act of kindness on another crazy day.
A "thanks-for-the-slow-Internet" dart to JMU. Sent in by a mad sophomore who doesn't think the $110 is worth the 20-minute wait to see a Web page.

A "why-not-put-some-of-our-tuition-money-back-toward-student-interests" dart to JMU for not placing enough bike racks around campus. Sent in by a disgruntled senior who feels that if the administration wants to increase the number of students to over 15,000, they should increase the number of bike racks accordingly.

A "you-made-this-faculty-member-proud" pat to the student who sacrificed her soda to put out a smoldering bush behind Jackson Hall. Sent in by a professor who appreciates your willingness to help out.

A "no-whine-just-wine" pat to my classy roommate for making sure that my otherwise useless 20th birthday was something to remember with a most sophisticated wine and cheese party. Sent in by someone who can't wait to make your 21st as memorable as her 20th was.

A "you-don't-live-here" dart to a certain neighborhood boy who made me watch Humphrey Bogart instead of letting me watch "Trading Spaces." Sent in by a neighbor who already can't wait to see you move out in May and thinks unless you want to pay her cable bill you better watch television at your house from now on.

A "keep-up-the-amazing-effort" pat to the Student Duke Club member in the hat who tried his best to get people cheering at the football game Saturday. Sent in by a crazy fan who realizes that you may not have much to work with, but doesn't want you to give up.

A "don't-be-an-elitist-indie-rock-meanie" dart to the harassing WXJM caller who claimed Harrisonburg radio stations were superior to my show. From a new disc jockey at the station who could have done without the tears to start off the week.
sender: a new disc jockey at the station

text: A "find-your-own-place-to-crash" dart to the random girl I found in my out-of-town roommate's bed at 4:30 a.m. Sunday morning. Sent in by a sophomore who thinks you should be extremely grateful that I let you sleep and didn't kick your sorry incoherent butt out of my room.

A "your-generosity-is-appreciated" pat to the girl who let me have her space in the parking garage when most students would have taken it for themselves. Sent in by a grateful junior who was so impressed by such a kind act.

A "you-bring-a-new-meaning-to-fast-food" pat to the guy riding the food-filled shopping cart down University Drive Monday. Sent in by two senior girls who don't know where you were headed, but hope you made it safely before your groceries melted.

An "I-wish-you'd-pee-on-the-electricity-box-instead-of-our-bushes" dart to the guy wizzing in broad daylight behind Wampler Hall. Sent in by some guys who live there who have a hard enough time with the dog food smell and don't need your urine stinking up the joint too.

A "you-saved-my-day" pat to the guy and girl in Southview who knocked on doors in the middle of the night to find the owner of the Blazer with the lights on. Sent in by a senior who always has car trouble and really appreciated not having to go through it again.

A "you're-too-disrespectful-for-words" dart to the person(s) responsible for the vandalism and thefts that took place in Z-lot this weekend. From a senior who doesn't appreciate that she now has to get her car fixed and thinks you're never too old to follow the "do unto others as you would have them do unto you" motto.

A "great-save" pat to the two library workers who smelled smoke while closing up Thursday night and called in the alarm. Sent in by a maintenance worker who knows your quick response prevented much more extensive damage.

A "learn-to-have-some-courtesy" dart to the professor who purposely blocked me from getting the parking spot my friends and I were waiting for and stole it after telling us it was now his spot just because he was faculty. Sent in by three annoyed junior girls who were appalled at such actions by a JMU professor.

A "thanks-for-trying-to-make-conversation" pat to the guy in green shorts lifting weights next to me at UREC. Sent in by a tongue-tied girl who wishes she had said more and gotten your number before running off to class.

A "thanks-for-not-really-considering-the-safety-of-your-students" dart to JMU for filling the slope of the walkway next to Interstate 81 with rocks the size of boulders. From a junior who has had to walk to ISAT twice a day, five days a week and enjoys the gravel walkway, but now fears for her life if she has to pass someone coming in the opposite direction.

A "you-guys-are-my-heroes" pat to the two sophomore girls who picked me up off the gravel path between two apartment complexes this past weekend. From a freshman girl who apparently still does not know her limits.

A "so-cross-the-street" dart to the ignorant ISAT walkers who can't locate the sidewalk on the other side of the road. Sent in by a junior who has found the sidewalk and is tired of all the stuff JMU students complain about.

A "learn-the-rules-of-the-road-or-at-least-discover-the-concept-of-common-courtesy" dart to the dangerously rude drivers who don't yield to pedestrians at the corner of Grace and South Main streets when the "walk" signal is on. From a professor who wonders if these impatient drivers have an inkling of how bad they would feel if they killed or seriously injured a pedestrian.

A "thanks-for-your-help" pat to the four people who pulled over and helped me push my broken-down car to a gas station in the rain. Sent in by a grateful junior who is thankful that she didn't have to spend the whole night in the middle of Port Republic Road.
A "huge-way-to-go" pat to the 3-1 JMU football team who upset No. 12 Hofstra University Saturday. Sent in by the Student Duke Club, an organization that always has and will continue to cheer you on.

A "get-a-life" dart to the immature seniors who thought revenge called for blowing up a bag full of dog poo with firecrackers in our living room. Sent in by an angry apartment of girls who still are trying to scrape the poo off the ceiling.

A "thanks-for-being-so-honest" pat to the three guys whose remote control car bumped into my lost wallet Tuesday night and who returned it to me with everything still in it. Sent in by a sophomore who is so happy to know that there are still honest people out there and promises to hold onto her wallet from now on.

A "thanks-for-being-so-crap-tastic" dart to our idiot neighbors for shooting out windows with a BB gun. Sent in by a senior who didn't realize that our apartment complex had suddenly become the new ghetto.

A "you-belong-in-the-zoo" dart to the animals who were spotted having sex on top of a radiator behind a certain apartment complex last weekend. Sent in by a few disturbed neighbors who think if they wanted to go on a safari they'd go to Africa.

A "you-guys-are-the-best-Phi-Sig-bigs-ever" pat to our wonderful big bros who somehow got Exit 245 to serenade us in our suite. From three littles who just died in your arms tonight over the surprise.
A "we-only-have-ears-for-you" pat to our favorite WXJM early morning disc jockey. Sent in by your three-girl-strong fan club who listen loyally even though your show comes on early Monday morning.
target: our favorite WXJM early morning disc jockey

text: A "can't-you-read" dart to all the inconsiderate smokers who choose not to follow the two signs outside the Health and Human Services entrance clearly stating "no smoking" and indicating the appropriate smoking location around the corner. Check out JMU smoking policy 1.11. Sent in by an employee who is seven months pregnant, has the right to breathe clean air when entering her work establishment and is amazed at how ignorant some smokers can be.

A "thanks-for-climbing-up-the-balcony-outside-our-second-story-apartment-building" pat to the incredibly cute guy who risked broken bones and the drunk neighbors' BB guns to add a little something special to my Saturday night. Sent in by a super-shy girl who thinks you're the hottest thing ever and will make your night by climbing in your window this weekend.

A "you-actually-cheered-louder-for-the-mascot-than-for-the-team" dart to all of the "fans" in the student section at Saturday's football game who should really pay more attention to the field. Sent in by an ashamed alum who remembers at least one group of guys who were rowdy the entire game no matter what the score.
A "tuh-tuh-tuh-today-junior" dart to the University Program Board. Sent in by a jam-band-loving junior who is tired of waiting for you to bring a decent musical act.

A "we-are-proud-that-you-provide-an-excellent-role-model" pat to a certain sociology major for her important work this summer documenting labor abuses at sweatshops in Central America. Sent in by faculty in the department of sociology and anthropology.
sender: faculty in the department of sociology and anthropology

text: A "your-presence-was-greatly-appreciated" pat to the 27 Alpha Sigma Tau sisters and pledges who recently drove to Northern Virginia and attended the Reston community Light the Night Leukemia Walk in memory of their AST sister, Sara C. Yakovac, JMU class of 2000. Sent in by a JMU Development officer who appreciates your thoughtfulness and consideration.
target: the 27 Alpha Sigma Tau sisters and pledges

text: A "hail-drama-queen" dart to my roommate who freaked out because I forgot to give her a chin when I painted her portrait. Sent in by your roomie who wants to know where you want her to roll out the red carpet.

A "thanks-for-being-so-chivalrous" pat to two awesome boys in 1180 Ashby who steam cleaned and scrubbed our entire house after the party we had Friday. From four senior girls at Foxhill who were overwhelmed at the idea of removing the beer and mud stains from their carpet and want you to know how much they appreciate you.

An "I-know-what-you're-doing" dart to the girl in D-hall whom I see every morning hoarding tomatoes, apples and other produce in her bookbag. Sent in by a loyal D-hall patron who doesn't appreciate you taking advantage of the fine dining establishment.

A "way-to-go-camping" pat to the guy on the Quad last Wednesday who was pitching a tent while he slept on his back. Sent in by the lingering girl who couldn't bear to move, yet somehow couldn't look away.

A "have-some-common-decency" dart to parking services for refusing to repeal the ticket they gave me while I was giving blood at a Sept. 11 blood drive. From a sophomore who says you should try walking after losing one fifth of your blood.

A "thanks-for-being-so-patient-and-on-the-ball" pat to the cute girl working in the CISAT copy center who helped me copy and bind for about 45 minutes. From an overwhelmed ISAT student with way too many tables and charts and who wants you to know your efforts didn't go unnoticed.

An "I-need-my-beauty-rest" dart to the roofers who skipped out on finishing their job this summer. Sent in by a music major who doesn't appreciate being woken up at 7 a.m. when she doesn't have class until noon.

An "I'm-singing-out-of-the-rain" pat to the girl who selflessly gave me a ride back to my apartment after I locked my keys and my phone in my car in the pouring down rain at BAT. Sent in by a very grateful guy who might still be standing in the parking lot had she not been so sweet.

A "who-does-that" dart to the unknown stranger who broke into my apartment late Friday night and pissed on my bedroom door. Sent in by a distraught transfer student who wonders what kind of people go here, anyway.

A "thanks-for-the-wake-up-call" dart to the Marching Royal Dukes on our only day of the week to sleep in. Sent in by two Shorts Hall roommates who wish the band would find somewhere else for pregame practice.

A "you-saved-my-life-and-I-wish-I-could-remember-who-you-are" pat to the girl who pulled me out of a manhole last Friday night.
