A "one-is-the-loneliest-number..." pat to the single remaining tree on the Quad that did not get wrapped with Christmas lights when the others did. From a bundled-up passerby who wonders where the rest of the lights are for the area tree.
A "better-you-than-me" pat to all the turkeys out there who won’t be gobbling much longer. From a thankful American who will be sad to see your life end, but also sad to see you go.
A "thanks-for-the-liquid-courage" pat to my two friends. From the happy birthday girl who thinks everyone should shotgun a beer in the Memorial Hall parking lot before giving a presentation.
A "that’s-real-cool" dart to the jackass who shattered our sliding glass door with the birthday mug. From three girls who hope your next drink is mixed with glass shards and laxatives — drink up.

A "holy-hot-bartenders-Batman!" pat to the hot bartender at Dave’s Taverna. From a girl who thinks your face is a national treasure.
An "I-am-never-eating-there-again" dart to the restaurant downtown that served me undercooked chicken. From a student who doesn’t appreciate getting food poisoning.
A "thanks-for-singing-in-the-shower" pat to my suitemate with the amazing voice. From a neighbor who enjoys free concerts while she gets ready in the morning.

An "I-know-you-see-me" dart to the person in the white SUV who almost ran me over in the crosswalk outside of Festival. From a student who would appreciate it if you’d stop at the big white lines next time.
An "I-do-read-your-status-updates" pat to my Facebook friends. From a girl who laughs, cries and sometimes rolls her eyes at your daily online musings.
An "I-don’t-care-how-cute-the-shoes-are" dart to the girl who clearly couldn’t walk in her heels on the ice outside of ISAT. From a passerby who would rather not watch you break your ankle.
A "thanks-for-opening-the-door" pat to all the guys who still hold doors open on campus. From a girl who appreciates chivalry.
A "thanks-for-testing-the-fire-alarm" pat to the guys in my apartment complex who pulled the fire alarm at 3 a.m. From a light sleeper who now knows that her smoke detector works.

An "I-know-you-stole-my-laundry" dart to whoever took my clothes out of the dryer and left them on the floor. From a student who is not amused by your idea of a prank.
A "you-saved-my-grade" pat to the girl who shared her notes with me after I missed a week of class. From a grateful student who won’t forget your kindness.
An "I-don’t-want-to-hear-your-life-story" dart to the person loudly talking on their cell phone in the quiet section of Carrier. From a student who came there specifically for silence.
A "thanks-for-helping-me-find-my-way" pat to the campus police officer who gave me directions instead of a ticket. From a lost student who appreciates the friendly help.

An "it’s-too-darn-cold-for-you-to-be-nonchalant-about-this" dart to whoever keeps propping open the residence hall door in January. From a resident who is tired of freezing just to walk down the hall.
A "thanks-for-not-kidnapping-me" pat to the random guy who gave me a ride back to campus when I missed the bus. From a grateful passenger who’s glad JMU is such a trusting campus.
A "pronto" pat to the Starbucks barista who remade my drink without me even asking after they got the order wrong. From a fellow fan of the band Cake whose day you made.

text: A "you’re-the-reason-JMU-professors-are-amazing" pat to the professor who gave away his old bike to a student in need. From a student who will cherish the ancient, but operable, bike.

An "it-might-not-take-you-the-entire-time-to-read-this" dart to the student who copied their friend’s homework word-for-word. From a classmate who actually did the assignment and respects that thing called the Honor Code.
A "you-don’t-belong-there" dart to the hair in my food at D-Hall. From a student who is grossed out more than you thought but would rather see you in the toilet.
A "happy-MLK-Day-to-you,-too" dart to the person who tore down the flyers announcing the MLK Day celebration. From the student who has put them back up at least 50 times since removing these items.

A "this-is-going-to-be-a-long-four-years” dart to my roommate who said, "It’s just another black guy” while watching the inauguration. From a student who is incredibly offended and hopes you realize the significance of this event.

A "you-bet-it-was-cold-out" pat to all the students who braved the freezing temperatures to attend President Obama’s inauguration. From a student who respects your dedication and looks forward to another weekend of fun!

An "if-you-deserve-that-color-steed,-then-you-deserve-the-responsibility-too" dart to the girl who constantly parks her bright yellow car in the fire lane. From a student who tries to keep his armor shiny at all times.

A "how-about-you-interview-students-on-a-Friday-night-before-noon-classes" dart to the news reporter who claimed all JMU students are drunkards. From a student who knows hangovers can be prevented with responsibility.
A "thank-you-for-making-my-night” pat to the group of guys who randomly started singing "Happy Birthday” to me in the middle of Sheetz. From a surprised room full of your new fans.

text: A "we-can-tell-Mickey-Matthews-doesn’t-care-about-your-jersey-as-much-as-you-do" dart to the football player who wears his jersey two sizes too small. From a fan who can see how uncomfortable you are, but keeps it on because it’s polite.
A "1,400-slices-of-cheese-is-cheaper-than-your-excuse" dart to D-Hall for denying my fellow students and me a delicious grilled cheese — on Grilled Cheese Thursday. From a cheesed-off sophomore.

An "I’m-trying-to-eat" dart to the repulsive couple going at it in the corner of D-Hall (and a super-pat to the chef who came and finally broke up the nausea-inducing pair). From a student who was trying to spend his Sunday morning recuperating.

A "thank-you,-JMU,-for-your-Wal-Mart-like-dedication" dart for remaining open when most off-campus parking lots were still frozen. From a senior who felt like he drove down a slip-and-slide to get to campus.

An "I-loved-how-I-didn't-have-to-get-out-of-bed" pat to the JMU Emergency System for sending me a text message saying we had a snow day. From a student who loved rolling over at 7 a.m. to discover she could sleep for four more hours.

An "it's-OK,-you'll-find-someone-special-someday" pat to the presumably lonely student who was seen watching hard-core pornography at the wee hours of the morning at East Campus Library. From a man who knows loneliness too.

A "you're-dirty" dart to my roommate, who leaves her dirty dishes in the sink and has a different guy over every week. From a roommate who takes out the trash, vacuums and cleans up without so much as a "thank you."

A "huge-part-of-our-community" pat to Clementine for letting a scene of our student film be shot inside your restaurant. From a movie crew who wishes all Harrisonburg businesses had the same attitude.

A "you-must-have-been-stoned" dart to the immature idiots who walked out onto Newman Lake in order to write "420" and then proceeded to post a video of their stupidity on Facebook. From someone who thinks you all should start acting like you're an educated person.

A "that's-the-spirit" pat to whomever transformed the old James Madison statue into a snowman (complete with carrot nose). From a junior guy who thought it was the perfect mix of school spirit and fun when he drove by last night.
An "I-love-you" pat to James Madison University. From a graduate student who just began her last semester here; it seems like just yesterday she was visiting and falling in love...
An "it's-not-over!!!" pat to the guys in Copper Beech who started the snowball fight on Tuesday. From some avid snow fans who will be ready next time it snows.
A "stop-abusing-me!" dart to all the alcoholics on campus. From your livers.
An "I'm-really-sorry-you-weren't-'the-one'" pat to the girl I hurt so badly. From your almost-unibrowed teddy bear.
An "I-feel-a-whoop-comin'-on" pat to Q101 for playing Tootsee Roll on my ride to class on Friday. From a senior who always enjoys a trip back to the '90s.
A "what's-the-point?" dart to the East Campus Library's fourth-floor deck. From a smoker who doesn't understand having it if it's always locked.
target: the East Campus Library’s fourth-floor deck

text: A "nobody-cares" dart to everyone who still has bumper stickers on their car from high school accomplishments (e.g. 2007 Homecoming Queen; Bethlehem High Lions; Miss Congeniality; "Honor Roll"; 2007 Prom Queen Runner-Up; National Merit Scholarship Applicant). From a senior who believes we have all moved on.
A "thanks-for-keeping-us-safe" pat to SafeRides for all your dedicated volunteers and recurringly successful nights. From someone who is very appreciative of all your hard work.

A "SORRY-I-HAVE-NO-MORE-TIME-FOR-YOU-all-I-do-is-STUDY-GO-TO-CLASS-GO-TO-WORK-AND-SPEND-MY-REMAINING-TIME-WITH-A-girl-who-I-have-known-for-a-month-AND-if-that-doesn't-work-out-I-WILL-HAVE-LOST-the-only-people-who-REALLY-CARE-about-me" dart to my roommate. From a frustrated roomie who misses their best friend.
An "I-love-my-roommates" pat to my four roommates who decorated my room and took me out to breakfast for my birthday. From the happiest fifth roommate in the Copperheads.

A "give-me-a-break" dart to the girl walking by Gibbons Hall who dropped her empty pack of cigarettes on the ground and kept walking. From someone who hates to see such beauty spoiled with your litter.

A "you're-lazy-and-inconsiderate" dart to my roommate, who always leaves her dishes in the sink "so they can soak" and has never cleaned our bathroom. From the roommate who always gets stuck cleaning up after you.
An "I-understand-that-life-is-hard" pat to the grounds crew who faced the wind and snow to scrape the sidewalks on Wednesday. From students whose morning classes were not disrupted.
A "we're-going-to-make-it-after-all" pat to my roommates. From the girl who is so excited that we all signed for the same townhouse again next year.

A "quiet-in-the-peanut-gallery" dart to all the girls who want to go to law school and "fight for justice" or "change the system" but are friends with the football team. From a guy who has seen people's opinions take a 180-degree turn when they begin to see that they might actually have something at stake.
A "two-year-contract-and-I-get-no-priority" dart to Verizon. From an annoyed customer.
A "you're-a-legend" pat to my wonderful boyfriend, who gave me the best Valentine's Day a girl could ask for. From the luckiest girlfriend on the face of the earth.
A "thank-you" pat to the wonderful boys who made sure our Saturday night was safe and drove us home, even though you went out of your way. From a group of girls who appreciate your kindness.
A "you-are-the-weakest-link" dart to a company here in Harrisonburg that didn't pay my boyfriend for three weeks. From a girl who knows you shouldn't mess with hardworking people.
A "you-are-so-funny" pat to my friends who sent me a singing telegram for my birthday. From a girl who was very embarrassed but secretly loved it.
An "I-can-do-anything-better-than-you" pat to the Army girls for beating the boys back to Memorial Hall this morning during the ruck march. From an amazed senior who's proud to be an Army girl.

A "somewhere-in-Egypt-there's-a-camel-missing-its-toe" dart to the girl who needs to learn that wearing leggings instead of pants is a privilege, not a right. From a fellow student whose day was spoiled by your inconsiderate wardrobe choice.

A "thanks-for-the-air-freshener" dart to the countless number of students who puff their cigarette smoke into other peoples’ faces while walking to class or standing outside doorways. A "thanks-for-making-our-dream-a-reality" pat to the W.M. Jordan Company. From the foundation to the flowers ... you guys are the best! From the University Health Center staff who love our beautiful new home.

A "that’s-not-the-JMU-way" dart to whoever stole my Nike University Recreation jacket from Copper Beech Townhomes two weekends ago. From a UREC employee who thought JMU was better than that, and would just really like her jacket back, please.

A "that-was-cold" dart to the girl who carelessly sent an icicle flying in my direction when I was trying to walk home. From someone who thinks you should know not to throw sharp sticks of ice, especially at others.

A "look-before-you-leap" dart to pedestrians who step out onto roadways without looking both directions. A vehicle cannot stop immediately and may be about to pass you at any time. From a driver who thinks pedestrians should worry about their safety as much as he does.

A "get-your-act-together" dart to Grafton-Stovall Theatre for having to cancel Friday’s showing of “The Wolf of Wall Street” because they had a faulty DVD. From someone who thinks you need to be more professional and maybe screen the DVDs before you show them.

An "I-will-find-you-and-I-will-kill-you" dart to the bird who decided to crap on my recently washed car. From your new worst enemy.
A "cuss-yeah" pat to Wes Anderson for making movies that have an original plot and style. From a woman who wishes she had a M. Gustave to teach her the ropes.
